intro: In Razorfen Kraul, Charlga Razorflank leads the Razorfen quilboar. They drove the tauren from the southern Barrens, claiming to fight in the name of their fallen god, Agamaggan.

p: Charlga Razorflank rules from the tangled brambles of Razorfen Kraul. Her people revere her as a master geomancer, and no quilboar can match her experimental magic. She united her fractious kin into a lethal force. With primal earth and giant thorns growing from the remains of the demigod Agamaggan, Charlga reshaped the Kraul into a fortress that is hard to enter.
